name: Mind map
description: A live radial mind map of your prifly sessions, the conversations they are about and their Trello cards, sorted into themes and linked.

llm.why: Groups your sessions, chats, mails and cards into topics and names them.

settings.label: Areas
settings.description: The map's themes, in your order. Areas are separated by ";" (or one per line). Each one is a name, optionally followed by ":" and a few words of hint, e.g. "Partners & integrations: Teamtailor, Jobylon". Leave this empty to let the model make up the themes.
settings.default: ODI / Artemis product; Partners & integrations: Teamtailor, Jobylon, Intelliplan, Eltel; prifly: prifly and its extensions; Proxy & datamining; Finance: Fortnox, Pleo, bokföring, invoices; Family & friends

panels.label: Mind map
panels.description: Your sessions, conversations and cards as one map
